brief.text: Create a botanical seed library with a spiral, seed-pod-inspired shell, visible seed drawers, curved ribs and glass specimen vials. Use warm ivory, botanical green and copper details, with an opening door or moving specimen carousel.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained seed library with its curved shell and specimen storage.

revisions.title: First refinement
revisions.description: First retained source-edit refinement after the initial whole-asset and detail views.

revisions.title: Unrendered intermediate revision
revisions.description: Second refinement retained for comparison. Rendering failed because the floor inlay referenced a material outside its scope; this is not the gallery version.

revisions.title: Current gallery revision
revisions.description: Changed the floor inlay to the available copper material, allowing the revised asset to render and export.
